gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor cancer excluding the following: MSI-low colorectal cancer, glioblastoma multiforme, prostate cancer, pancreatic cancer, mucosal and ocular melanoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: A Study of the PD-L1xCD27 Bispecific Antibody CDX-527 in Patients With Advanced Malignancies

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Receipt of all standard therapies for the tumor type

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: CDX-527 serum concentrations will be measured at specified visits.

role_evidence.quote: Eligible patients will receive CDX-527 treatment based on cohort assigned until progression or intolerance.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma multiforme appears only as an exclusion. MSI-H colorectal cancer appears only as a listed condition; the exclusion of MSI-low colorectal suggests MSI status selects colorectal patients. Tumour biopsy is required only 'if required' with no stated pharmacodynamic endpoint. PK is serum only.
